part2.question: Describe a happy person you know

segments.v: I want to talk about Mr. Bình. He is the security guard in my apartment building. He is about 65 years old. He is always happy and smiling. He says hello to everyone and he remembers everyone's name. He is very friendly. When I had my entrance exam, he said “Good luck” to me and I felt better. He often sings old songs and he feeds the cats in the car park. I think he is happy because he likes his simple life. He does not have much money but he is happy with his family and his job. He likes helping people. I think he is a good person and I learned from him that money is not everything.
